As in previous years, the selection process shall consist of two phases, the first of which is a Written Test (hereafter called the "test").
The test is scheduled for Saturday, 24 January 2026
, 10:30 am to 1:30 pm, IST.
The second phase of selection is an online interview, for which candidates shall be shortlisted based on the test scores.

Again as in previous years, the same test shall serve towards selection for both scholarships. At the time of application, applicants may opt to be considered for only one of the scholarships (either one) or for both. Separate interview shortlists shall be drawn up for the two scholarships, based on the test scores. For further details, including such matters as eligibility, please refer to the detailed advertisement (linked above).
